source_name: Kristóf Bérczi, Áron Jánosik and Bence Mátravölgyi, “Cyclic ordering of split matroids”, arXiv:2411.01061 (2024).
statement: Let $(B_1,\dots,B_k)$ and $(B'_1,\dots,B'_k)$ be sequences of $k$ bases of a matroid. Two sequences are **compatible** if the union of the $B_i$ as a multiset equals the union of the $B'_i$ as a multiset, and they are **equivalent** if one can be obtained from the other by a composition of symmetric exchanges. **White's conjecture.** Two sequences of $k$ bases are equivalent if and only if they are compatible. The compatibility condition is an evident necessary condition; the source records the assertion as open in general.
title: White's basis-sequence equivalence conjecture
